episode.title: Woolly Mammoths Coexisted With The Great Pyramid

synopsis: Woolly mammoths were still roaming a remote Arctic island while workers built the Great Pyramid in ancient Egypt.

title_card.title: Mammoths existed with the pyramids.
title_card.subtitle: They roamed the Arctic 4,500 years ago.

caption:
Woolly mammoths were still alive on a remote Arctic island when the Great Pyramid was being built, about 4,500 years ago. An isolated population survived on Wrangel Island until around 1700 BC. Meanwhile in Egypt around 2500 BC, workers were assembling massive stone blocks.

Visuals created with AI.

Did you know mammoths survived this long?
